#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Radarr: update download client 1 with credentials
RADARR_KEY=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/radarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" | head -n 1')
pct exec 103 -- sh -c "curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H 'X-Api-Key: $RADARR_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"$MASS_PASSWORD\",\"movieCategory\":\"radarr\"}' http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/1"

# Sonarr: update download client 1 with credentials
SONARR_KEY=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\(.*\)</ApiKey>.*:\1:p" | head -n 1')
pct exec 104 -- sh -c "curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H 'X-Api-Key: $SONARR_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"id\":1,\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"$MASS_PASSWORD\",\"tvCategory\":\"tv-sonarr\"}' http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/1"

# Test Radarr download client
pct exec 103 -- sh -c "curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H 'X-Api-Key: $RADARR_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/test/1"

# Test Sonarr download client
pct exec 104 -- sh -c "curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H 'X-Api-Key: $SONARR_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/test/1"
